narrative_engine.thesis: Volatility is coiled (ATR percentile 18%, EMA spread -3.12 ATR) — the honest play is patience. Do NOT fade the range: compression resolves explosively, and the highest-value action is standing ready with the M1 pullback plan the moment a stack aligns.
